title: The Renaissance of Zero-Build Static Websites
summary: Why vanilla modern HTML5, CSS custom properties, and native ES modules are more capable than ever for personal portfolios and tools.
content:
### The Shift Towards Simplicity

For years, the default approach for any web project—even a personal site or documentation page—was setting up heavy bundlers, massive dependency trees, and thousands of node_modules packages.

Today, modern web standards have evolved to provide out-of-the-box superpowers that previously required external toolchains.

### What Native Web Standards Give Us Today

1. **CSS Custom Properties & Nesting:** Native design tokens and clean hierarchy without preprocessors.
2. **CSS Grid & Flexbox:** Truly responsive layout control with zero external CSS frameworks.
3. **Native ES Modules (import/export):** Modular, structured JavaScript directly in all evergreen browsers.
4. **Fetch & Web Storage APIs:** Lightweight state persistence and asynchronous data loading.

Simplicity isn't a compromise—it's a deliberate design advantage that keeps personal sites fast, accessible, and maintenance-free for years.
